_note: Answer bank used by the JobFill extension. Rules are checked top to bottom; first match wins. q = regex on the question label (case-insensitive). a = text answer ({placeholders} resolved from profile/job). pick = regex choosing an option in dropdowns/radios/yes-no buttons. avoid = options never to pick. never = leave for Rohit (consents, legal declarations). choice_only = only answer dropdown/radio versions. Per-job overrides go in applications/<id>/answers.json. not = regex that disqualifies a rule. type = text typed into search dropdowns (| separated alternatives).
